title: Exploited Puppet report deserialization permits server code execution
summary: A crafted rich-data report submitted with any CA-signed agent certificate can execute code as the Puppet Server service account. Weak automatic certificate signing can remove the authentication barrier.

severity.rationale: CISA confirms exploitation of a flaw reaching server code execution. Configuration-management infrastructure can hold privileged deployment capabilities.

exposure: The attacker needs a CA-signed agent certificate, or a weak autosigning policy that issues one without strong verification.

params.instructions: Check Puppet Enterprise version, affected release line and the documented exposure conditions.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade to Puppet Enterprise 2023.8.13, 2025.12.1 or 2026.0.1, bundling puppet-agent 8.22.2 or 9.1.3, and restart Puppet Server.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed release meets the corresponding fixed version and verify the affected workflow with harmless test inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
